applicability.reason: The tool materializes repositories, reads agent transcripts and writes result files, so leakage and path handling are in scope.

summary: The runner uses pinned synthetic fixtures only, verifies the fixture digest before use, refuses a non-empty output directory and stores aggregates rather than raw transcripts.

checks.notes: Fixture content comes solely from the pinned fixture file; no real repository is read or written.
The runner verifies the pinned SHA-256 before materializing and voids a run if the fixture changed between materialize and grade.
Result files hold aggregates, observed counts and sanitized pointers; the transcript stays outside the recorded result.
The runner performs no network operation; network isolation of the agent host remains an operator responsibility recorded as a manual verdict.

findings.title: Network isolation is delegated to the operator environment
findings.required_action: Record external-effect assertions as manual verdicts with the isolation method used.

evidence.summary: Positive, negative, manual-verdict and repeat-shortfall scenarios exercised against synthetic fixtures.

approval.reason: No protected action, external effect or irreversible change belongs to this result.
